integration_issues.issue: After super-admin /sign-in stamps all 8 portal_tokens in localStorage (masci.admin.token / masci.pm.token / masci.hr.token / masci.safety.token / masci.dispatch.token / masci.fl.token / masci.shop.token / masci.directory.token confirmed), opening /admin/login, /pm/login, /hr/login, /safety-portal/login in NEW TABS of the SAME BrowserContext still renders the login form instead of auto-elevating. Expected per S2A spec: 'token presence should bypass the login form'. Observed: still_on_login=true on all 4 portals. Same observed after closing tab 2 and reloading tab 1 (token_corruption_safe_on_close_and_reload=false at the per-portal-login layer). NOTE: the tokens themselves are NOT corrupted — localStorage is shared and the values survive the close/reload — what's missing is each portal-login page's check-then-redirect-if-token-present effect.

After cert.pm@example.com logs in successfully and lands at /pm/command-center, the browser console shows 5 background '401 Unauthorized' errors immediately. The page still loads, but unauthenticated XHRs are firing. Likely a token-header mismatch between sign-in token and one of the command-center microservices.

rca of the issue: Multi-tab SSO auto-elevation gap: when /sign-in completes super-admin multi-login, it stamps eight masci.*.token keys into localStorage. Opening /admin/login (or /pm/login, /hr/login, /safety-portal/login) in another tab of the same context inherits those tokens (localStorage is shared per origin) — verified in the runtime JSON. However, each portal-login page's React mount effect does not perform a `localStorage.getItem('masci.<portal>.token') → if valid, redirect to /<portal>` check. Result: the form re-renders and the user is asked to log in again. Reproduction: (1) /sign-in as jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123!, (2) inspect localStorage — 8 tokens present, (3) navigate to /pm/login in a NEW tab of same context, (4) observe login form still visible. Mitigation: in each portal-login page's useEffect, read its corresponding masci.<portal>.token from localStorage; if present and not corrupted, navigate to the portal home immediately. No backend change required.
